encoding: EnumSort(Name, [__main__, Tensile.Tensile]); pred = (__name__ == __main__). String equality over a 2-value finite enum; mirrors ExpressionEvaluator compare(==) op-surface over an enum-valued symbol.
notes: Module-guard predicate. Pure string equality over the seeded finite enum domain; both branches solver-proven sat by z3 (TRUE: __name__==__main__; FALSE: __name__==Tensile.Tensile). No isinstance / nodeType / os / filesystem / gpu probes, so classified fully-static for solver purposes. Caveat for downstream: the VALUE of __name__ is fixed by the Python interpreter at load time (==__main__ only when the file is executed directly; ==Tensile.Tensile when imported as a module) and is not driven by CLI/YAML input -- it cannot be steered by public input. In this repo the guard is dead-on-import: running Tensile/bin/Tensile imports the module so the FALSE branch is taken; the TRUE branch (prints the deprecation notice and exits 1) fires only if someone runs python Tensile/Tensile.py directly. No PURE helper extracted: the predicate is a bare enum equality with no auxiliary inputs to feed CrossHair.
